_source.title: Deputy Group Manager- Business Continuity Planning
_source.description: A career in IBM Consulting embraces long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process...
_source.body: A career in IBM Consulting embraces long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI-powered workflows.  You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.   Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience. Reports to the Global Business Continuity Manager; Co-lead the business continuity management program supporting Asia Pacific, with direction from the global business continuity manager and team Perform on-going business continuity management across Asia Pacific including India, Malaysia, Philippines, and China. Effectively collaborate with Site leadership and Business Continuity Coordinators.  Oversee business continuity plan readiness and compliance with maintenance, testing including risk/gap remediation, on-going measurements / reporting and audit support Provides guidance and direction to client account teams and country business continuity coordinators to ensure their business continuity processes are in accordance with global business continuity management program and standards Assist with other business continuity activities as required to maintain and improve the overall continuity management program Business Continuity Plan Development during transition in collaboration with Process owner. Lead performing BC plan creation based on standard templates and development process. Collaborates with all stakeholders to meet transition deliverables. Maintain business continuity management process documentation and templates. 2-3 years of Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery planning/ Operational Resilience and management experience with overall experience of 8+ years. Knowledge of business continuity planning, or program management methodologies or similar capabilities.  Cross-functional Project Management experience with attention to details meeting project plan milestones and deliverables Strong Teaming skills both as a leader and team player Ability to develop strong relationships, influence and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders. Strong written, verbal communications and presentation skills Experience with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project.  Nice to have experience with Agile methods and tools (such as Monday, Mural) Industry certifications such as CBCI, CBCP, ISO 22301or equivalent would be a plus. _source.description: A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic...
_source.body: A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP HANA Billing, you will design, develop, and deploy billing processes for clients, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems. You will provide expert guidance to clients on best practices for billing and revenue management, leveraging your expertise in SAP HANA Billing solutions. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Design and Develop Billing Processes: Design and develop billing processes, including data mapping, data migration, and testing, to meet client requirements and ensure successful integration with existing systems. • Configure SAP HANA Billing: Configure and customize SAP HANA Billing to meet client needs, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery. • Client Engagement and Training: Conduct workshops and gather requirements from clients to understand their billing needs, and provide training and support on SAP HANA Billing functionality and best practices. • Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain technical documentation and user guides to support client understanding and adoption of SAP HANA Billing solutions. • Solution Integration: Integrate SAP HANA Billing with other SAP modules, such as SAP ERP and SAP CRM, to deliver comprehensive billing solutions. • SAP HANA Billing Configuration: Experience with configuring and customizing SAP HANA Billing to meet client requirements, including data mapping, data migration, and testing. • Billing Process Development: Experience in designing and developing billing processes, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems, such as SAP ERP and SAP CRM. • Technical Integration: Experience with integrating SAP HANA Billing with other SAP modules, including data migration and testing, to deliver comprehensive billing solutions. • Client Requirements Gathering: Experience in conducting workshops and gathering requirements from clients to understand their billing needs and provide expert guidance on best practices. • Technical Documentation Development: Experience in developing and maintaining technical documentation and user guides to support client understanding and adoption of SAP HANA Billing solutions. • SAP HANA Module Knowledge: Experience with other SAP modules, such as SAP ERP and SAP CRM, is beneficial for integrating SAP HANA Billing and delivering comprehensive billing solutions. • Data Migration Expertise: Familiarity with data migration and testing is advantageous for ensuring seamless integration of SAP HANA Billing with existing systems. • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exposure to collaborating with cross-functional teams can facilitate successful project delivery and effective client engagement. _source.title: Procurement Operations Lead & People Manager
_source.description: At IBM Finance & Operations, we are the backbone of IBM's transformation driving efficiency, transparency, and smart decision-making across the business. Our teams provide the insight and discipline that guide strategy, ensure financial strength, and...
_source.body: At IBM Finance & Operations, we are the backbone of IBM's transformation driving efficiency, transparency, and smart decision-making across the business. Our teams provide the insight and discipline that guide strategy, ensure financial strength, and enable IBM to invest in innovation and growth. Working in Finance & Operations means combining analytical skills with collaboration and curiosity. You'll partner with colleagues across functions and geographies, using data, technology, and process excellence to create solutions that improve performance and deliver measurable impact. IBM offers continuous learning, career development, and a culture that values diverse perspectives. Join us and be part of a global team that keeps IBM moving forward, while building your own future in a dynamic and evolving environment. Job Title: Procurement Lead & People Manager Role Overview We are seeking an experienced, client-facing People Manager with deep end-to-end procurement expertise to lead operational delivery teams, drive SLA/KPI compliance, and act as a trusted escalation point for key client stakeholders. Key Responsibilities People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage performance, capacity, and career development for a team of procurement specialists across daily operations. Client Governance: Serve as the primary operational point of contact for client stakeholders; lead governance reviews, manage escalations, and maintain high client satisfaction. End-to-End Procurement Delivery: Oversee the full Source-to-Pay (S2P) lifecycle—including sourcing support,contracting, supplier enablement, purchase order (PO) resolution, and invoicing—ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and quality baselines. Process & Backlog Optimization: Monitor operational metrics, resolve transaction bottlenecks, enforce process boundaries against scope creep, and drive continuous improvement and automation initiatives. Required Qualifications Experience: 6+ years in global procurement operations, with at least 3+ years directly managing teams and client relationships. Domain Expertise: Proven hands-on mastery of end-to-end S2P workflows, contract lifecycle management,supplier onboarding, and PO/invoice issue resolution. Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of enterprise ERP and procurement platforms (e.g.Oracle) and data-driven reporting. Leadership & Communication: Decisive, accountable leadership style with executive-ready communication skills to align internal teams and external stakeholders. _source.description: About IBM IBM India since 1992 provides solutions and services spanning all major industries including financial services, healthcare, government, automotive, telecommunications and education, among others. As a trusted partner with wide-ranging service...
_source.body: About IBM IBM India since 1992 provides solutions and services spanning all major industries including financial services, healthcare, government, automotive, telecommunications and education, among others. As a trusted partner with wide-ranging service capabilities, IBM helps clients transform and succeed in challenging circumstances. The diversity and breadth of the entire IBM portfolio of research, consulting, solutions, services, systems and software, uniquely distinguishes IBM India from other companies in the industry. Business Unit Introduction IBM Research - India ([1] https://research.ibm.com/labs/india) invites applications for its Internship Program in Quantum Computing and associated topics in Computer Science, Mathematical Sciences, and AI at its locations in Gurgaon and Bangalore.  References Visible links 1. https://research.ibm.com/labs/india IBM Software Innovation Lab is the global IBM organization that executes the research agenda focused on next-generation data systems, agents and automation, and drives these innovations at scale into IBM's Software product portfolio. IBM Software Innovation Lab - India ([1] https://ibm.biz/ibmsilindia) invites applications for its Internship Program in Next Generation Data, AI Agents and AI-driven automation at its locations in Gurgaon and Bangalore. References Visible links 1. https://ibm.biz/ibmsilindia Software Innovation Lab Intern - AI & Data Summer Internship Program is one of the major activities under the University Relation Program. IBM Software Innovation Lab India offers Summer Internship to the bright students of leading technical Universities in India. IBM Software Innovation Lab India provides industry experience and world class technologies to these students to show their talent. During internship students work on current projects happening in the lab, they solve problems with the help of their mentors. Idea is to give industry experience to the students and look for future employees. We are looking for a talented and highly motivated scientist / engineer to contribute to our research and development efforts across multiple frontiers of AI. The candidate will work on innovation projects that are grounded in real-world datasets, environments and problems while also pushing the state of the are in agentic AI technology with a specific focus on enterprise applications. Areas of research include AI for IT automation, intersection of data and AI, agentic middleware and models, embedding and AI-based retrieval, time series foundation models, multi-modal foundation models and AI for software engineering. Research Intern - Quantum Algorithms Summer Internship Program is one of the major activities under the University Relation Program. IBM Research India offers Summer Internship to the bright students of leading technical Universities in India. IBM Research India provides industry experience and world class technologies to these students to show their talent. During internship students work on current projects happening in the lab, they solve problems with the help of their mentors. Idea is to give industry experience to the students and look for future employees. Research Intern - AI Summer Internship Program is one of the major activities under the University Relation Program. IBM Research India offers Summer Internship to the bright students of leading technical Universities in India. IBM Research India provides industry experience and world class technologies to these students to show their talent. During internship students work on current projects happening in the lab, they solve problems with the help of their mentors. Idea is to give industry experience to the students and look for future employees. We are looking for a talented and highly motivated engineer/scientist to contribute to our research and development efforts across multiple frontiers of AI. The candidate will work on one or more research areas: building and scaling large language models, agentic systems that work with small language models, auto evolution of agents including testing and debugging of agents, software stack for AI Accelerator cards, intersection of data and AI, and programmable language models. Eligibility Criteria  * B.E. / B.Tech  * M.E. / M.Tech (including Dual Degree programs)  * Ph.D.  * Minimum 70% or 7.0 CGPA and above in the pursuing degree  Time Duration  The internship will be conducted between May and August 2027, for a maximum duration of 3 months. Software Innovation Lab Intern - AI & Data  *Excellent coding skills in Python (including Pandas, NumPy)  *Strong grasp of Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem Solving  *Solid foundation in Linear Algebra, Probability, and Statistics  *Hands-on experience with VS Code, Jupyter Notebooks, Git *AI/ML Fundamentals: supervised & unsupervised learning, classification, regression, neural networks, clustering *Learning fundamentals and Data Manipulation/Analysis for large datasets *Proficiency in AI libraries/frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch  * Experience in Deep Learning, Foundation Models, Large Language Models  * Familiar with Generative AI frameworks such as langchain and crew.ai  * Expertise in unstructured data processing. Research Intern - Quantum Algorithms The Quantum Algorithm Engineering team collaborates with partners to produce state-of-art demonstrations on IBM Quantum hardware. The following are our expectations: * Theoretical foundations in quantum computing. Algorithms like QAOA and sampling-based diagonalization algorithms that have scalable demonstrations on quantum computers of today.  * Strong coding skill in Qiskit  * Ability to read research papers on quantum algorithms and applications and implement their methodology   Research students, especially senior PhDs, will be provided preference to this role. Anyone with strong prior experience in large-scale algorithm demonstrations on quantum computers are encouraged to apply. Research Intern - AI  * Strong programming fundamentals in Python  * Solid understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning   * Familiarity with Large Language Models, Generative AI, Transformers and NLP  * Hands-on experience with VS Code, Jupyter Notebooks, Git  * Exposure to AI Accelerator software stack * Proficiency in AI libraries/frameworks: PyTorch  * Exposure to AI Agents, tool use, function calling, reasoning models   * Familiarity with techniques such as LoRA/PEFT, knowledge distillation, reinforcement learning, or RLHF/RLAIF is desirable.  * Ability to read, understand, and critically analyze research papers. Experience implementing ideas from research papers is highly desirable. * Ability to reproduce research results and design-controlled experiments. Software Innovation Lab Intern - AI & Data * Experience working with platforms such as Watsonx.ai or similar  * Familiarity with risks associated with AI deployments, including agents going rogue. Research Intern - Quantum Algorithms * Understanding of classical domain background with respect to the quantum application being worked upon. For eg., some among tensor networks, classical optimization (theory or SOTA heuristics), computational chemistry, classical machine learning, etc. * Quantum circuit optimization and error mitigation algorithms, and their implementations on Qiskit.  * Standard coding skills in Java/Python (including pandas, NumPy), Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem Solving, linear algebra, probability, statistics, Experience with VS Code, Jupyter notebooks, Git Research Intern - AI Exposure to popular RL libraries and hands on experience with RL training. Familiarity with concepts on linear algebra, probability, statistics and to fundamentals of LLM models.
